properties.source: Drawn by hand from Britannica's text description, not its map images. The Fertile Crescent arc outside the Levant (the feature adds the `levant` card's shape and NE 'Mesopotamia'): Hauran and Damascus east of the Anti-Lebanon, then the rain-fed belt along the Taurus foothills (Aleppo, Gaziantep, Urfa/Harran, Mardin) to the upper Tigris, overlapping NE 'Mesopotamia' (Breasted's arc as described by Britannica 'Fertile Crescent'). No Nile. Cut from the earlier whole-arc drawing by subtracting geometry/levant.geojson, so the two share an edge. Approximate.
refs: Natural Earth 10m v5.1.2 (public domain), commit f1890d9
